subject: ela
intro: On the SAT, 'Cross-Text Connections' questions give two short paired passages by different authors on one topic and ask how one author would likely respond to the other, or how their views compare. You must identify each author's position, then relate them (agree, disagree, qualify).

items.prompt:
Text 1 argues that homework improves learning. Text 2 argues homework mostly causes stress with little benefit.

How would Text 2's author most likely respond to Text 1?

steps: Text 2 opposes homework's value; Text 1 supports it.
So Text 2's author would disagree, arguing the benefit is overstated.
solution.answer: Disagree, arguing that homework's learning benefit is overstated.
